reason: Lists the shared workflow catalogue, filtered to distribution='addon' and active=true. mike_workflows holds the catalogue synced from the upstream workflow repository, not user data: every authenticated user is meant to see the same rows, so there is no caller identity to scope by. REMOVE WHEN: addons become per-user or per-organization, at which point this handler needs a tenant filter rather than an allowlist entry.

Reads one catalogue addon by id, with the same distribution='addon' and active=true filters as the list endpoint. Catalogue content is global, so there is no owning user to check. REMOVE WHEN: addons become per-user or per-organization.

Serves an asset attached to a catalogue addon for display. The asset belongs to the addon, which is global, and the handler re-checks the addon is an active addon before serving it. REMOVE WHEN: addons become per-user or per-organization.
